messages:
nina: Planning a staggered tenant_id type swap on orders table tonight 02:30 UTC. This will run as CTAS per-shard then swap. Request: pin deploybot to schema-v4.0.0 for the window and disable canary in ap-south-1. Estimated 2.5h. Any concerns?
asher: Ack. Which shards and swap strategy?
nina: Shards: 0-999 then 1000-1999, etc. CTAS into orders_new, backfill via chunked copy, then atomic rename. We'll do 1 shard at a time with 10m health pauses. Expect very short exclusive rename locks (~1-3s).
bryce: Abort criteria suggestion: sustained p99 DB latency >400ms for >8m OR replica_lag>75s OR API error rate increase >0.4% over baseline for 5m. Also if more than 2 rename failures in a row.
nina: Agree. Add: if backfill churn causes disk temp >85% on primary -> abort.
asher: Fallback if deploybot cannot pin: gate by feature flag 'orders_tenantid_swap' = false and abort any in-progress jobs. @bryce can you manual-unpin?
bryce: I can manual-unpin and flip the flag. I'll be on pager. :ok_hand: 
deploybot: Pin request accepted. Pinning schema-v4.0.0 for release-group 'orders-tenantid-swap' at 2794512345. Canary disabled in ap-south-1. Will post progress every 12m and emit alerts on p99/replica_lag/disk usage.
opsbot: Drafted release note at release_notes/2794512345.md: "Tenant ID type swap on orders table. Per-shard CTAS and rename; brief rename locks possible. Rollback/runbook and abort criteria in thread."
pagerbot: Monitoring hooks added: p99 latency, replica_lag, API error rate, disk usage. Will page on configured thresholds.
nina: Runbook snippets:
```bash
# start backfill for shard range
./backfill_copy --table=orders --dst=orders_new --shard=0 --chunk-size=5000 --concurrency=1
# atomic swap
psql -c "BEGIN; ALTER TABLE orders RENAME TO orders_old; ALTER TABLE orders_new RENAME TO orders; COMMIT;"
# emergency abort: flip flag and stop jobs
psql -c "UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='orders_tenantid_swap';"
```
bryce: Quick unpin CLI: `deployctl pin --release-group orders-tenantid-swap --unpin`
asher: We'll run smoke queries after each shard: `./scripts/smoke_orders.sh <shard>` for 10m, require success before next.
nina: I'll start shard-0 at 02:40 UTC (10m after window open) to let ops reconcile. Deploybot please confirm pin and post start.
deploybot: Confirmed: schema-v4.0.0 pinned and scheduled. Test shard-0 started at 02:40 UTC. Progress updates every 12m. Alerts enabled.
bryce: On pager and ready to manual unpin if thresholds hit.
opsbot: Added notes: disable heavy analytics from 02:20 -> 05:30 UTC and ensure disk alert thresholds lowered to 80% for the window.
nina: Thanks team. Will post 12m pings and a final green before proceeding to shard-1000.
